race.comment: Onto the G1 Thousand Guineas and siding with REGAL AMBITION (9) through a fantastic win in the Jim Moloney Stakes last time out. She was slowly away but really ripped home there to win well having also reeled off huge splits to win fresh. She should relish the mile and is the one with all the upside. She beat PRETTY BABY (2) fair and square there although PRETTY BABY did start a clear favourite. PRETTY BABY would potentially prefer soft ground and has been up a while but gets a nice run for D Lane. Very wary of OVER THE BRIDGE (8) who is 2/2, too strong on speed here last time. Goes 1200m to 1600m but Maher has a history of doing similar things, have to respect. DE ARMAS (4) was similarly 1200m to 1600m in the G1 Flight Stakes and ran very well albeit in moderate figures. Can improve again for Waller. SAINTLY DANCER (3) bolted in the G2 Edward Manifold at Flemington on heavy ground, she'll give a sight again.
